title: Early access lighthouse retention and feedback signal matrix
creator: Priya Desai
description: Objective: Define and execute an early-access program for lighthouse accounts that prioritizes retention measurement and a signal-driven feedback loop to inform the GA release. This ticket coordinates release notes, cross-functional GTM tasks, instrumentation, and success criteria for the first 10 lighthouse customers. Scope: onboarding flows, retention funnel instrumentation (activation, week-1 retention, M1 retention), release note cadence, post-launch evals, and playbooks for CS/solutions engineers.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes draft for early access completed and approved by Docs and Legal (pull request GH#4821)
Retention & activation dashboard live in Looker with daily refresh and baseline cohorts (activation, day-1, week-1)
Signal matrix documented and published to Confluence with prioritized actions (triage/resolution/playbook)
Onboarding checklist and runbook handed to CS and Solutions with rehearsal completed for first 3 lighthouse accounts
Feedback loop defined: weekly synthesis, tag taxonomy, and evals pipeline connected to Redwood Optimize metrics

decisions: Rollout model: staggered lighthouse cohorts (3 -> 3 -> 4) to allow prioritized fixes between waves
Minimum GA criteria: week-1 retention >= 45% for ≥7/10 lighthouse accounts or action plan approved by PM/Eng/CS
Release notes cadence: weekly early-access digest plus immediate hotfix notes for any production regressions
Instrumentation: use unified event taxonomy across hosted and dedicated customers to simplify cohorting
